summary: Iteration 8 (stability & reliability hardening) — All 14 backend tests passed. Verified: (a) /api/health returns 200 JSON {status:ok, db:up}; (b) global Exception, PyMongoError, and ServerSelectionTimeoutError handlers are registered on app.exception_handlers; (c) invalid payloads (missing mobile / string amount) return 422 and backend stays alive (subsequent /api/health still 200); (d) AsyncIOMotorClient pool options: max_pool_size=25, min_pool_size=1, connect_timeout=5s, socket_timeout=20s, wait_queue_timeout=5s, server_selection_timeout=5s, retry_writes=True, retry_reads=True; (e) supervisor [program:backend] autorestart=true and PID stable across health round-trip; (f) 30 concurrent httpx GET /api/health all returned 200 with no exceptions; (g) regression on OTP send/verify, /api/dashboard (pending_list present), worker+contractor /api/settlements, /api/feedback create+list, /api/reports/pdf?worker_id (valid %PDF header).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1504 lines — still recommended to split into modules (auth.py, reports.py, feedback.py, payments.py, stability.py) for maintainability.
@app.on_event('startup') and 'shutdown' are deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan handlers to avoid future breakage.
Global Exception handler is correctly registered AFTER app.include_router(api). Order preserves HTTPException's built-in handler (correct).
Health endpoint returns 200 even in 'degraded' state (db down). Consider returning 503 when db=='down' so external uptime monitors flag the incident. Current behavior only logs a warning.
PyMongoError and ServerSelectionTimeoutError handlers both return 503 with sensible detail — good.
CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router; that's fine for FastAPI but a common gotcha — worth a comment.
Mongo client uses appname='farmlog' — helps DB-side profiling. Nice.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/otp/send — abuse vector (SMS bomb in production once wired to Twilio). Add per-mobile + per-IP throttle.
test_credentials: Ephemeral mobile OTP dev flow — dev_otp returned by /api/auth/otp/send.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral OTP user + TEST_Stab8W (worker, deleted), TEST_Stab8C (contractor, deleted), TEST_Stab8PDF (worker, deleted), one TEST_Stab8 feedback record left under ephemeral user (no cleanup impact).

For future ServerSelectionTimeoutError verification without patching, could add a fake route that raises the exception and confirms 503+'Database temporarily unavailable' — currently skipped per task instructions.
